name: WinMain
comment: reads game.ini, inits gfx, menu/game loop

name: master_Step
comment: per-frame master step; param_2 = subsystem flags (0x200 scripts, 0x40 3d, ...)

name: timer_Start
comment: multimedia timer: period 14 ms increments tick counter

name: anim_Attach
comment: start animation on object slot (3 slots)

name: evt_ImportCommand
comment: register host function (name, fn, ret, argc, types...)

name: g_date
comment: u32 round (&3 season), u16 hour @4, minute @6

name: geb_SumObjectPrices
comment: building price = sum of installed object prices

name: date_Add
comment: (date, hours, minutes, seconds) with carry into round

name: crc_Checksum
comment: checksum over a buffer (header checksum for network saves)

name: sv_Read
comment: fread wrapper used by every section loader

name: sv_WriteHeader
comment: header: city, date, owner identity, player checksums, thumbnail, save name

name: sv_SaveCharacters
comment: characters section incl. local player slot

name: sv_LoadMessageQueues
comment: timed messages (8192) + network command log (0x8000) + acks

name: net_SaveGame
comment: every machine: exchange header checksums, write own NAME.SRV/.SAV

name: menu_SearchNetwork
comment: join browser; lists saved games only if the local copy matches

name: net_HostLoadGame
comment: host: read own header, wait for header human count

name: menu_NetLobby
comment: lobby; identity from [Network] in game.ini or the local save header

name: net_StartNewGame
comment: host streams the city file, clients receive it

name: net_StartSavedGame
comment: every machine loads its own local .SAV

name: ls_ReceiveGame
comment: load a world from the received buffer

name: gm_PlayerLeftToAI
comment: turn a departed human's character into an AI one (kind 5, new name)

name: gm_LocalPlayerDeath
comment: local player died: succession / game over

name: gm_CreateCharacter
comment: allocate and initialise a character (playermode = kind)

name: dbg_CharacterLine
comment: tab-separated debug dump of a character (decodes text fields)

name: gm_CharacterWealth
comment: cash plus possessions of a character

name: ai_IsLocalCharacter
comment: process this character on this machine (network split)

name: ai_IsLocalEmployee
comment: same for employees of a character

name: cm_ExecCommand
comment: execute received network commands via table 0x635030 (sequence check, acks 0xf5d320)

name: cm_RequestSetDate
comment: command 0x1e with a date (single player: sent to itself)

name: cm_ExSetDate
comment: command 0x1e: set g_date if newer, run one simulation step

name: nt_Init
comment: connect to the server (address 0 = offline single player)

name: clk_Advance
comment: timer callback (every 71 ticks ≈ 1 s): local date += (speed*0.00625+0.5)*100 s

name: timer_Tick
comment: multimedia timer callback: run registered timers, g_tick++

name: cm_Send
comment: queue a command record for the server (or loop back when offline)

name: msg_ProcessNotices
comment: every game minute: run handlers of notices whose deadline passed

name: chr_UpdateDrives
comment: every game minute: update the 13 drives of every character

name: chr_UpdateDrivesOne
comment: value += rate - decay*value (0..1000); strongest drive -> activity +0x130

name: eco_MinuteStep
comment: economy value at 0x71d06c follows elapsed time between 07:00 and 21:00

name: ai_ScoreAction
comment: weighted drive values for an action (current activity counts more)

name: ai_Schedule
comment: every game minute: visit 12.8 character slots (hourly update, AI decision)

name: date_MinutesBetween
comment: whole minutes from a to b

name: chr_HourlyUpdate
comment: employees with job flag: schedule repairs of worn objects (condition < 40..71) in the workplace

name: ai_Decide
comment: staff own workshops (hire), choose (ai_ChooseAction) and run (FUN_00484150) an action; +0x132 = action

name: ai_ChooseAction
comment: candidate targets from office holders with relationship scores, then action scoring

name: cm_RequestAddNotice
comment: command 0x1c with a 0xf8-byte notice description (sent as blob)

name: cm_ExAddNotice
comment: command 0x1c: create the notice (only for the local player's characters unless shared)

name: cm_SendBlob
comment: send a payload larger than a record via commands 8/9
